title: A Database For The Collection Of Clinical, Laboratory, And Treatment Data From Patients With Factor X Deficiency To Define The Natural History Of The Disease And Improve Patient Management
official: Coagulation Factor X Deficiency: Natural History And Disease Management
summary: Factor X deficiency is one of the most severe rare bleeding disorders and may lead to serious spontaneous hemorrhages, particularly in patients with severe congenital forms. Acquired FX deficiency is even rarer, most frequently associated with AL amyloidosis, and remains poorly characterized. Establishing a comprehensive patient registry is essential to improve understanding of disease epidemiology, clinical manifestations, and treatment outcomes, ultimately supporting evidence-based management strategies.
